title: Ultrasound Guided Core Biopsy vs Fine Needle Aspiration for Evaluation of Axillary Lymphadenopathy
brief_summary: The study was performed to determine if either ultrasound guided core biopsy or fine needle aspiration of an axillary lymph node has superior sensitivity in detecting metastatic carcinoma from the ipsilateral breast.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women with breast cancer and abnormal ipsilateral axillary nodes visible on sonography.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to understand consent form.
* Emotionally unprepared to discuss possibility of axillary metastasis
* Node not amenable to core biopsy
condition: Focus: Breast Cancer With Axillary Node Metastasis
